subject: Engineering Fundamentals
title: Fusion Energy: Engineering a Star on Earth
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Fusion Energy: Engineering a Star on Earth.

hook.text: The sun produces energy by fusing hydrogen atoms. Engineers want to recreate that process in a lab.

buildup.text: Fusion requires heating plasma to 150 million degrees — ten times hotter than the sun's core.

discovery.text: In 2022, the National Ignition Facility achieved ignition — more energy out than laser energy in.

twist.text: The total energy gain was about enough to boil a kettle. The lasers required 300 times that energy to fire.

climax.text: ITER in France is building a tokamak reactor. If it works, fusion could provide limitless clean energy.

punchline.text: We can create a star. We just can't keep it lit.

quiz.question: What milestone did the National Ignition Facility achieve in 2022?
options: It sustained a fusion reaction for over one hour continuously
It produced more fusion energy than the laser energy used to trigger it
It used fusion power to generate electricity for the first time
